race.description: Nutrien Ag Solutions St Arnaud Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: LADY MAESTRO (8) turned in a sound effort last time but found a couple better at Kyneton over 1103m, beaten 1.5 lengths. Cherry-ripe now and won't find this anywhere near as tough. FIRST DIVISION (2) turned in a decent effort last start when she did her best work late to finish second over 1103m at Kyneton. Draw is potentially tricky but certainly has the class to take this out with the right run. ASAWIN (4) was in contention on the corner and finished third last time over 1175m at Manangatang when resuming from a spell, beaten only 3/4 of a length. Repeat of that makes him a chance here and he's drawn to get her chance. KRASNOLUDEK (1) resumes here and didn't do anything at his only fresh run, which was on debut, and will appreciate this class.
